title: Catalin A NDE 2146
content: It was a clear sunny day on a late spring if I'm not mistaken and I went with my father to the backyard of a school where he used to teach sports. He had a group of eighth grade students running around him in a circle, probably for warm-up, was focused on their activity, and didn't worry about me, as I was about twenty meters away from the circle playing. I decided to go to my daddy, as I got bored of being by myself. I started towards the group searching for him (everybody seemed so tall at that time as I was only five). The older kids obstructed my sight of him for several seconds with their 'giant' bodies so that it was a little harder than I'd have expected. Nevertheless, a few moments later I managed to spot him, which made me so happy that I simply decided to run to him as fast as I could. It was a terrible mistake because in doing so a boy accidentally collided with me while attempting to enter the circle. I fell to the right hand side as the students rushed from the left and hit my head severely. There was no pain whatsoever except for a very short moment when I had the unpleasant feeling of being forced to the ground in a somewhat brutal way. Immediately after the impact, I saw an extremely thick fog all around me. In spite of the daylight, I could not make anything out because the fog was so thick. It only lasted for about ten seconds but I can't be sure of it and then everything changed. This is where the unexplainable begins: Suddenly my vision was perfect; my hearing also, but to me everything seemed to be normal. I saw my dad picking me up and carrying me in his arms to hospital, which was pretty close to the school. He met a man on his way who asked what had happened, there were two schoolgirls who came with us to the hospital, and then I don't remember anything else from that moment till I woke up as it's been over twenty years since. After actually being awake, I could see my mother along with the two girls from school staring at me and talking worryingly about my accident. It was no big deal to me at that time but as time went on I asked myself a lot of questions as I remember clear things that occurred while I was in a coma. context.nde_cause_other_detail: Head injury from collision/fall during school sports activity; went into a coma.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Extremely thick fog immediately after impact, lasting about ~10 seconds, then normal-seeming perception while apparently unconscious/comatose.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Reported an 'extremely thick fog' immediately after impact before perception became 'normal' with perfect vision/hearing during coma.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “Immediately after the impact, I saw an extremely thick fog all around me.”; “Suddenly my vision was perfect; my hearing also, but to me everything seemed to be normal.”; “I saw my dad picking me up and carrying me in his arms to hospital…”; “Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? Everything about the universe.”
